title: The current-active type-check scope
note: The scope partitions every tracked Python file; check() fails on any error or any mypy failure; the summary is read, never assumed.

mutations.name: TS1_everything_is_active
mutations.rationale: the legacy QTA tree would be held to the active scope, or (inverted) silently counted as checked

mutations.name: TS2_a_sibling_prefix_is_inside
mutations.find: return any(path == s or path.startswith(s + "/") for s in scope)
mutations.replace: return any(path.startswith(s) for s in scope)
mutations.rationale: tools_old/ or scientificx.py would be counted as active

mutations.name: TS3_no_summary_is_clean
mutations.find: raise RuntimeError("mypy printed no summary:\n" + output[-2000:])
mutations.rationale: a crashed mypy reads as zero errors

mutations.name: TS4_errors_do_not_fail_the_check
mutations.find: return 1 if errors or code else 0
mutations.rationale: the CI step passes over a scope with errors

mutations.name: TS5_untyped_bodies_are_skipped
mutations.rationale: mypy's default skips the bodies of unannotated functions, so half of the active scope is never read
